title: 第112章 险境突围密影现身第111章 峡谷伏杀暗处暗流
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 漫天火球裹挟滚滚热浪砸向峡谷谷口，赤红火光映亮两侧陡峭崖壁。
灼热气流翻涌，卷动地面堆积的枯枝败叶四处飘飞。
风刃划破空气的尖啸，在狭长山谷间反复回荡。
石壁夹缝生长的低矮灌木，被法术逸散的余温烤得发黑。
一缕淡淡的焦糊气味，伴着山间清风慢慢散开。
萧辰带来的七名门人，结成三面合围的阵势，牢牢锁死林宸周遭的活动空间。
一众弟子修为最低炼气八层，最高已是炼气巅峰。
每人手中握着一件下品法器，刀剑斧刃在火光下寒光粼粼。
昨夜所有人连夜奔波，一边在峡谷地面埋设捆缚绳网，一边耗费灵力炼制淬毒暗器，整宿没有片刻休整。
丹田内的灵力储备本就损耗严重。
此番围杀，他们早已商定好用车轮消耗的打法。
近身修士贴身缠斗牵制，余下之人轮流释放火球术、风刃术。
慢慢榨干林宸灵力，等到对方力竭之后，再一拥而上完成斩杀。
萧辰独自站在包围圈后方的青石上，一身青色弟子劲装，掌中长剑微微震颤，炼气巅峰的灵力在体内缓缓流转。
数次交手过后，他早已清楚林宸的战力远超同阶，心底恨意深重，又带着几分忌惮。
他没有急于入场厮杀，只是静静注视战场。
耐心等候林宸灵力不济、招式出现破绽的瞬间，再持剑上前给出致命一击。
此前灰衣人暗中洒落的阴寒毒粉，毒素依旧潜藏在林宸的经脉缝隙之中。
接连不断的躲闪与施法，持续刺激体内毒素。
丝丝阴冷气流游走四肢，时不时带来一阵酸麻滞涩的异样痛感。
林宸身负寂灭道体，当下肉身还被凡尘浊气禁锢，道体无法彻底解封。
可与生俱来的灵气亲和天赋依旧起效。
周遭游离的天地灵气被肉身不停吸纳入体，一边弥补斗法带来的灵力消耗，一边缓慢中和经脉内的阴毒，稳稳按住了毒素爆发的苗头。
道体的秘密被林宸刻意掩藏。
萧辰、灰衣人还有暗处潜伏的白衣人影，只能察觉他修行、肉身天赋异常，完全不清楚寂灭道体的来历。
林宸单手紧攥下品短剑，剑锋起落，精准格挡迎面劈来的各类兵器。
历经无数生死搏杀沉淀的战斗经验，能让他瞬间捕捉对手出招的细微破绽。
脚下踏动御风诀，身形辗转腾挪。
身处重重围困之下，总能在法术袭来前寻到空隙闪避，还能借机反击，逼得近身的修士连连后撤。
一名炼气九层的魁梧光头弟子，依仗肉身强横，瞅准空档抡起厚重铁斧全力劈落。
斧风裹挟厚重风压，落地扬起漫天尘土，直接封死林宸落脚之处，逼他只能硬接攻势。
林宸眸光冷冽，不愿耗费灵力硬碰重型兵器，脚步横挪半寸，贴着斧刃劲风贴身突进。
短剑寒光一闪，在对方小臂划出一道寸许深的伤口，温热血水顺着皮肉滴落泥土。
剧痛之下，光头弟子闷哼出声，握斧的手腕脱力，踉跄后退两步。
原本严丝合缝的合围阵型，当即裂开一处缺口。
“立刻补位，不能放他冲出峡谷！”
萧辰见状厉声呼喊，身形快步前冲，长剑凝起灵力直刺缺口，以炼气巅峰的修为封堵林宸的突围路线。
他心里十分清楚，一旦让林宸脱出包围圈，靠着对方精妙身法，众人再想围杀便再无半点可能。
谷口旁的树荫之下，下毒的灰衣人抱臂而立，全程冷眼观战，没有半点出手相助萧辰的想法。
他受幕后之人指派，任务只有下毒耗损林宸根基、半路拖延行程。
萧辰一行人，不过是用来试探深浅的棋子。
能斩杀林宸自是大功一件，若是落败，也能借着这场厮杀摸清林宸的底细。

Fireballs all over the sky hit the mouth of the canyon with rolling heat waves, and the red flames illuminated the steep cliffs on both sides.
The scorching air surged, and the dead branches and leaves accumulated on the ground flew everywhere.
The scream of the wind blade cutting through the air echoed repeatedly in the narrow valley.
The low shrubs growing in the cracks of the stone walls were baked black by the residual heat of the spell.
A faint burnt smell slowly dispersed with the breeze in the mountains.
The seven disciples brought by Xiao Chen formed a formation that surrounded Lin Chen on three sides, firmly blocking the space around Lin Chen.
The lowest cultivation level of the disciples is the eighth level of Qi refining, and the highest level is the peak level of Qi refining.
Each person held a low-grade magic weapon in their hands, and the blades of swords and axes shone coldly in the firelight.
Everyone worked all night long last night, burying rope nets on the canyon floor and spending their spiritual energy refining the poison-quenching hidden weapon. They didn't have a moment to rest the whole night.
The spiritual energy reserves in Dantian were already severely depleted.
In this round of siege, they had already agreed on the strategy of using wheels to consume them.
The close monks fought and restrained him, while the remaining people took turns releasing fireball and wind blade techniques.
Slowly drain Lin Chen's spiritual power, wait until the opponent is exhausted, and then rush forward to kill him.
Xiao Chen stood alone on the bluestone behind the encirclement, wearing a blue disciple's uniform, the sword in his palm trembling slightly, and the spiritual power at the peak of Qi refining slowly flowing through his body.
After several battles, he already knew that Lin Chen's combat power was far superior to that of the same level, and he felt deep hatred and a bit of fear in his heart.
He was not in a hurry to enter the battlefield and just watched the battlefield quietly.
He waited patiently for the moment when Lin Chen's spiritual power was exhausted and flaws appeared in his moves, and then he stepped forward with his sword to deliver a fatal blow.
The cold poisonous powder that the man in gray had secretly sprinkled before was still hidden in the gaps in Lin Chen's meridians.
The continuous dodging and casting of spells continue to stimulate toxins in the body.
A stream of cold air travels through the limbs, causing a strange sense of soreness, numbness and stagnation from time to time.
Lin Chen is carrying the Tao Body of Nirvana. At the moment, his physical body is still imprisoned by the turbid air of the mortal world, and the Tao Body cannot be completely unsealed.
But the innate aura affinity talent still works.
The free spiritual energy of heaven and earth around him is continuously absorbed into the body by the physical body. While making up for the consumption of spiritual energy caused by the fighting skills, it slowly neutralizes the poison in the meridians, and steadily suppresses the signs of toxin explosion.
The secret of Taoism was deliberately hidden by Lin Chen.
Xiao Chen, the man in gray and the figure in white lurking in the dark could only detect the abnormality in his cultivation and physical talent, and had no idea about the origin of the Nirvana Dao Body.
Lin Chen tightly grasped the low-grade dagger with one hand and raised and lowered the sword's edge to accurately block all kinds of weapons coming towards him.
Combat experience accumulated through countless life-and-death battles allows him to instantly detect the subtle flaws in his opponent's moves.
He stepped on the Wind Control Technique under his feet, and his body moved around.
Under heavy siege, he can always find an opening to dodge before the spell attacks, and he can also take the opportunity to counterattack, forcing the monks who are close to him to retreat.
A burly, bald disciple at the ninth level of Qi Refining, relying on his physical strength, looked for an opening and swung the heavy iron ax down with all his strength.
The ax wind carried heavy wind pressure, and when it hit the ground, it raised dust all over the sky, directly sealing Lin Chen's footing, forcing him to continue the offensive forcefully.
Lin Chen's eyes were cold, not wanting to waste his spiritual energy on confronting the heavy weapon head-on. He moved half an inch sideways and charged forward against the strong wind of the ax blade.
The dagger flashed with cold light, and cut an inch-deep wound on the opponent's forearm. Warm blood dripped down the flesh and into the soil.
Under the severe pain, the bald disciple groaned, the wrist holding the ax gave out, and he staggered back two steps.
The originally tight encirclement formation immediately opened a gap.
"Take up the position immediately, don't let him rush out of the canyon!"
Xiao Chen shouted sharply when he saw this, and rushed forward quickly. His long sword gathered spiritual power and pierced the gap, blocking Lin Chen's breakout route with his peak Qi refining level.
He knew very well that once Lin Chen was allowed to escape from the encirclement, relying on the opponent's exquisite body skills, it would be impossible for anyone to encircle and kill him.
Under the shade of the trees next to the valley entrance, the poisoned man in gray stood with his arms folded, watching the battle with cold eyes, without the slightest idea of ​​helping Xiao Chen.
He was assigned by the person behind the scenes, and his mission was only to poison Lin Chen to destroy Lin Chen's foundation and delay the trip halfway.
Xiao Chen and his team are just chess pieces used to test the depth.
Being able to kill Lin Chen is a great achievement. If he fails, he can also find out the details of Lin Chen through this fight.
